method.renderer: Electron via CDP CPU sampling, Performance.getMetrics, longtask observer and requestAnimationFrame intervals
method.development: Actual Minnow Electron main and preload with Vite and isolated MINNOW_HOME
method.production: Built dist via shipped server-host HTTP stack in a separate Node process; Electron BrowserWindow with workspace context and without native tray bridge
method.frameCaveat: rAF intervals measure scheduling gaps, not a compositor dropped-frame counter. CDP setup can contribute an isolated long frame.
method.slowdown: 4x CDP CPU throttle is an artificial sensitivity test, not measured local-model GPU contention.
method.historyFirstPaintCaveat: Production history 1x firstPaintMs can include the loading placeholder. Use its final rows and frame distribution; 4x histories were already loaded.
method.scope: Product fixes measured with the same isolated history fixtures and scripted workloads. No original conversation bodies or credentials included.
method.productionHarness: Explicit CDP Page.enable before workspace injection. Restarted static server and isolated browser after rebuild; failed stale-asset attempts excluded.
method.timingCaveat: Single before/after sweep, not a statistical trial. Stream and account completion times include variable provider/network latency.
method.finalPagerCheck: After the performance sweep, visual QA identified CSS smooth scrolling affecting programmatic scroll correction. Requested-page correction now temporarily uses auto scrolling, restores the host preference, and passed the new regression and a repeated requested-page profile. Unrequested history and app-switch workloads do not perform this correction.

validation.note: Test groups overlap; counts must not be summed as unique tests. Focused rerun uses repository runner flags including test-force-exit; an initial manual invocation without it remained open, and the rerun with the repository flags passed.

cli.prompt: Write exactly five short numbered lines explaining why small software changes are easier to review. No introduction or conclusion. Do not call tools.
cli.scope: Production generation adapters to local stream subscriber; excludes browser paint. Synthetic prompts only.
